== Summary ==
[[Leslie Burns]] at Decipher, 1996. Head-centred crop of [[:File:Leslie Burns splicing 70 mm film, InQuest 17 (1996).jpg]]. Photo: InQuest.

== Source ==
* Rick Swan, "Star Tours: How a ''Star Wars'' card is made", ''[[InQuest]]'' 17 (September 1996), pp. 54–60; photographs on p. 55. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-issue-17-images_202008/page/n56/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n56). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Identification: the printed caption reads "Leslie splices images from the original 70 mm film on the editor." The article's only Leslie is "Leslie Burns, Decipher production manager (and Dan's sister)".
* Crop: box 1213,1078 to 1373,1305 of the leaf, head centred.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a magazine article about how Decipher made ''Star Wars'' CCG cards, used only to identify Leslie Burns on her article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.
